EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning
Final Narrative: On April 10, 2023, at approximately 8:35 a.m., an employee was unjamming a packer machine when her left middle fingertip was pinched by a denester plate, resulting in amputation.

EventTitle: Contact with objects and equipment, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee was cleaning machinery when they sustained lacerations on their hand from the machine blade.

EventTitle: Struck by rolling object or equipment being pushed by another  person
Final Narrative: On January 8, 2015, at approximately 8:40 PM, an employee's leg was caught between a tugger and rolling stock another employee was moving.  The employee was taken to the hospital where he was admitted due to a possible fracture and swelling.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level less than 6 feet
Final Narrative: An employee was unloading pressure treated lumber with a forklift. The employee tried to pick up three loads of lumber, but realized that the load was too heavy for the forklift. As he placed the load onto the ground, the forklift extended forward, causing the employee to fall forward out of the forklift. The employee sustained a head laceration.

EventTitle: Injured by slipping or swinging object held by other person
Final Narrative: An employee was holding a stake in place while a coworker used a sledgehammer to strike it in place for forming. The employee lost his balance and held onto the stake at the same time that it was being struck by the sledgehammer. The sledgehammer struck and broke his left index finger.

EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning
Final Narrative: An employee had been realigning a conveyor chain at an unscrambler. The employee went back to grab a board off the conveyor the machine started. The employee's arm was pinched between the chain and the unscrambler wall; the employee suffered fractures to the left ulna, radius, and hand, as well as a laceration between the left thumb and forefinger.

EventTitle: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in nonroadway area, unspecified
Final Narrative: On August 26, 2020, an employee was placing a sticker on a trailer in a yard when a tractor ran her over. She suffered a leg injury and was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part
Final Narrative: An employee was performing a quality check on incoming materials on a machine's feed line. A nearby forklift operator was attempting to lift a two-tiered stack of cardboard for loading into the machine when the top tier fell on the employee. The employee's right leg broke in several places, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation
Final Narrative: The employee was connecting a rod for rock coring/sampling.  The rod is approximately 2" in diameter by 5' long, weighing about 15 pounds.  The head of the auger rig turns the rod.  The employee was using a 24" wrench to tighten the rod.  The employee activated the rig to help torque the rod.  The employee was injured when he put his hand between the pipe wrench and the turning auger rig.

EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning
Final Narrative: An employee was working on a grain dryer when it lacerated his left thumb.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level  less than 6 feet
Final Narrative: On January 13, 2025, an employee was standing on a two-step step ladder while removing lights from a Christmas tree when they fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip and femur.

EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation
Final Narrative: An employee was drilling holes into an angle iron using a drill press when a piece of their clothing got caught in the drill, resulting in injuries to their hand and wrist.

EventTitle: Struck by running powered equipment  during maintenance, cleaning, testing
Final Narrative: On October 22, 2025, an employee was working to put a conveyor chain back on the track of a conveyor when their fingers were caught between the chain and the chain track, pulling their right hand into the sprocket. Four fingers were amputated.

EventTitle: Struck by object or equipment, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee was a welder tasked with moving an idle roller with a forklift used to stabilize ships for welding operations. As he was positioning dunnage under the idle rollers for the forklift, the idle roller slipped, crushing his left foot. He was hospitalized and required surgical amputation of his left big toe tip.

EventTitle: Struck by object or equipment, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee was reattaching the coil lifting device to the overhead crane. The coil lifting device struck and fractured the employee's lower right leg.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level 11 to 15 feet
Final Narrative: An employee was descending a ladder after placing a scaffold plank when he lost his footing and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground, breaking his ribs and pelvis.

EventTitle: Struck by discharged object or substance
Final Narrative: On April 18, 2017, at approximately 9:00 p.m., an employee was using a spray nozzle when it stopped working then suddenly started up again. He lost control of the nozzle and sprayed his right thumb lacerating it. He was hospitalized for surgery on a torn tendon.

EventTitle: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
Final Narrative: An employee and his supervisor were carrying a boiler part (weighing approximately 110 to 120 pounds) in tandem and placing it atop a pile. The employee was wearing Kevlar Gloves covered with rubber gloves (i.e.; two layers of gloves). The employee was helping to stabilize the boiler part on top of another part already stacked in the pile. The part the employee was adjusting shifted and the employee's left index finger was pinched between two parts. The employee tried to pull his finger out of the pinch point, and suffered a fingertip amputation with the loss of some bone.

EventTitle: Direct exposure to electricity, greater than 220 volts
Final Narrative: An employee in a bucket truck was untying phases of a 7,200-volt three-phase line before a construction crew could change out a pole. The employee came in contact with a lightning arrester and was shocked. The employee also sustained electrical burns.

EventTitle: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
Final Narrative: An employee was using a rope to move a sick cow out of a pen. The cow suddenly moved and the employee's fingers were caught between the rope and a saddle horn. His right index, middle, ring, and little fingers were amputated.

EventTitle: Struck by falling object or equipment, unspecified
Final Narrative: A duct support structure was being assembled. Its framing fell, pinning an employee under it. The employee suffered a broken arm (with muscle damage) and a laceration to the leg.

EventTitle: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object
Final Narrative: An employee was hooking up air lines on a trailer when the employee's heel became caught on a buffalo box (curb box). The employee then fell backwards onto a fire hydrant, fracturing the lumbar vertebrae.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level 6 to 10 feet
Final Narrative: An employee was installing vinyl siding on a one-story garage from a plank supported between ladder jacks. The employee placed a 4-foot step ladder on the scaffold plank to install the last piece when they fell 10 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a crush injury to the L2 vertebra.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level  less than 6 feet
Final Narrative: A driver was exiting his vehicle outside the plant gate when his foot slipped on the top step of the truck. He fell to the ground, landed on his left hip and elbow. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip/femur.

EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation
Final Narrative: An employee was threading a 5/8-inch round bar into a machine. A spinning bar caught his glove and pulled in his left hand and fingers. He sustained an amputation, laceration, and fractures to the thumb, index finger, and middle finger.

EventTitle: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
Final Narrative: An employee was helping a backhoe operator place a concrete inlet box. The employee was holding the wire rope cable with his left hand when the backhoe lifted the box. The cable cut the employee's hand, resulting in a finger amputation.

EventTitle: Fall from collapsing structure or equipment less than 6 feet
Final Narrative: An employee was at a customer's house, walking up to the front door when the wooden stairs broke. The employee's foot went through the broken stairs to the ground and he felt a pinch in his lower back. The employee tried to get up and walk, but he could not and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized overnight for a lower back injury.

EventTitle: Nonroadway collision with other vehicle, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee was directing small trucks in a parking lot while riding a scooter. After directing a coffee truck towards the dock area, he was returning to his original spot when he was struck by a truck. He suffered injuries to his back and multiple other body parts.

EventTitle: Struck by propelled, falling, or suspended object  unspecified
NatureTitle: Cuts, lacerations, punctures without injury to internal structures
Final Narrative: An employee was working on a garage door to fix the bracket that holds the spring coil. While putting the bracket back in place, the spring coil came undone which made the bracket spin and lacerate the employee's right forearm.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee fell while carrying boxes down a flight of stairs, suffering contusions.

EventTitle: Contact with hot objects or substances
Final Narrative: An employee was disconnecting a 2-inch coupler on a steam line to remove a clog. The coupler had been loosened an hour earlier to release pressure. The employee loosened the coupler further to perform the maintenance and was hit with steam on the right arm and back. He suffered second-degree burns.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level less than 6 feet
Final Narrative: An employee was entering the cab of a 18-wheeler and fell backwards striking his head. He was hospitalized for a head injury.

EventTitle: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part
Final Narrative: An employee was operating a forklift to lift an aluminum pallet up to a second-story mezzanine. He then got off the lift to push a button to open the mezzanine gate when the pallet slid off the base of an unassembled bin. The employee saw the moving pallet and tried to move back to dodge it. The pallet struck the employee on the shoulder, pushing him to the ground and resulting in a fractured clavicle.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee was helping to unload a truck at a gas station. The employee was walking on the back of the truck when their right knee popped, causing them to fall 5 to 6 feet to the concrete below, landing on their back and left elbow. The employee was hospitalized with torn ligaments in their right knee and a fractured kneecap.

EventTitle: Thrown, fell, or jumped from animal being ridden
Final Narrative: An employee was saddled in their horse monitoring other horses on a walking trail when a guest dropped their reins. The employee leaned forward to grab the guest's reins. The employee's horse then backed up about 10 steps, reared up, and fell over, causing the employee to fall off and the horse then landed on the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized with a broken tibia.

EventTitle: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
Final Narrative: An employee was reassembling food processing equipment after cleaning it. As the employee was positioning the auger screw in the auger screw housing, a coworker pushed the end of the auger screw into the housing, causing the employee's right hand to be pinned between the auger screw and the auger housing. The employee's index and middle fingertips were amputated.

EventTitle: Exposure through intact skin, eyes, or other exposed tissue
NatureTitle: Second degree chemical burns and corrosions
Final Narrative: An employee was cleaning the equipment and floors in an area when an ammonia release occurred. The employee was exposed to the ammonia and suffered second degree burns to her right leg, requiring hospitalization.

EventTitle: Injured by slipping or swinging object held by injured worker
Final Narrative: An employee was removing groove filler from a vinyl extrusion piece using a handheld cutting tool. The tool lacerated the back of the employee's left hand and the employee was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Fall through surface or existing opening 11 to 15 feet
Final Narrative: An employee was securing materials for transport on a roof when they tripped over a skylight and fell 15 feet through the opening onto the concrete floor. The employee sustained a skull fracture.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee tripped while descending a flight of stairs, breaking an ankle.

EventTitle: Hitting, kicking, beating, shoving
Final Narrative: An employee was helping to restrain a combative patient in an emergency room. The patient attacked and fell backwards onto the employee's left leg, causing a fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

EventTitle: Pedestrian struck by vehicle backing up in nonroadway area
Final Narrative: An employee was carrying trash to a compactor when a forklift backed up over his right foot. His foot was crushed and required hospitalization.

EventTitle: Nonroadway noncollision incident, n.e.c.
NatureTitle: Traumatic injuries to spinal cord, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee was loading a parked trailer using a forklift when the trailer began to drive off. The forklift with the employee rolled off the trailer and landed on its back side. He suffered spinal injuries and was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object
Final Narrative: A home health care employee tripped on an outdoor lighting fixture and fell to the ground outside of a patient's residence, resulting in a concussion.

EventTitle: Pedestrian struck by vehicle backing up in nonroadway area
Final Narrative: An employee was checking for an oil leak under a truck. The truck began to back up into a bay, and its wheel partially ran over the employee before it stopped. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level 26 to 30 feet
Final Narrative: An employee was running cable from a residence to a terminal when his cable line was snagged by a box truck. He was pulled off of his ladder and fell approximately 28 feet, injuring his back.

EventTitle: Struck by object or equipment dropped by injured worker
Final Narrative: An employee was lifting a box that weighed about 50 lbs. out of the back of his truck and dropped it on his foot. He experienced a loss of feeling in his foot and was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Struck by object or equipment, unspecified
Final Narrative: An employee was removing a street light when the base kicked back and struck the employee in the stomach area.

EventTitle: Struck by falling object or equipment, n.e.c.
Final Narrative: An employee used a T-bar to prop open a trailer door prior to cleaning the trailer. The T-bar fell and struck the employee in the head and neck, resulting in a concussion.

EventTitle: Caught between rolling powered vehicle and other object
Final Narrative: An employee was maneuvering a motorized pallet jack while standing in front of it. He became pinned between the pallet jack and a steel rack cross-beam, resulting in a contusion to his chest/back and a fractured rib.
